# Units

<!-- purpose: Where Units files live, the kinds they hold and every key they accept -->

*This page is generated from SWCraft's own definitions, and describes the version you have installed.*

Units, one file each under `data_types/units/`: the unit a physical value is measured in, an element a type names by reference. One kind, `unit`, which an application type names as its `unit_ref` and a `linear` compu method as its `unit`. The directory is mandatory and may be empty.

One file per `unit`, in `data_types/units/` under the model root, named after its `name` and ending in `.yaml`. Where that file name is already taken by another element's file — compared without regard to case — the file gets the nearest free `~1`, `~2`, … instead; the element is identified by the `name` inside the file, never by its file name.

## `unit` { #unit }

<!-- purpose: Writing `unit` files in Units: each key, its type and default -->

A unit, emitted as a `UNIT` in `/DataTypes/Units`: the name a type's physical value is measured in and the text it is shown as. An application type names one by its `unit_ref`, in place of the inline `unit` text, and a `linear` compu method by its `unit`. A unit's SI relation and physical dimension are not held, so every unit has the defaults the standard gives them.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | — | The unit's identity; the file is named from it (`data_types/units/{name}.yaml`, or a suffixed name when another file collides case-insensitively) and is never what identifies it. Unique across the units, must not be blank, and immutable; an element of another layer may carry the same name. |
| `display_name` | string | no | `""` | The text the unit is shown as (for example `km/h`), written as the `UNIT`'s `DISPLAY-NAME` exactly as held; the empty default writes none. |
| `description` | string | no | `""` | Free text about the unit. Written into the generated ARXML as the element's `DESC`, exactly as held; the empty default writes none. |
| `package` | string | no | absent | The one sub-package of `/DataTypes/Units`, its layer's package, this unit is emitted in, a single SHORT-NAME segment: the unit and every reference to it take `/DataTypes/Units/{package}/`. Absent means `/DataTypes/Units` itself. It is held to the AUTOSAR Identifier rule. |
